description: This file configures a service worker for a Qwik-based frontend application, focusing on prefetching, and sets up lifecycle event handlers for install and activate events.

classes.name: ServiceWorkerGlobalScope
classes.description: TypeScript declaration for the global scope within a service worker, allowing type-safe access to service worker APIs.

methods.name: setupServiceWorker
methods.description: Initializes the service worker with default or customized configuration for Qwik city prefetching.

methods.name: addEventListener
methods.description: Adds event handlers for service worker lifecycle events such as 'install' and 'activate'.
